name: seraphic-legions-descent-enter-banishes-angels-from-deck-hand-memory-and-graveyard-and-draws-into-memory
notes: Seraphic Legion's Descent had no implementation of its On Enter. Added $enterAbilities['QX72P4Xx1A:0']: choose any amount of Angel allies in the deck (MZMULTICHOOSE) and banish them, then any amount from hand/memory/graveyard, shuffle the deck, and draw into memory once per card banished from hand and memory. Banished cards get a seraphicLegion counter. The champion's lineage includes a TERA card so the Exalted element is enabled.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Search your deck for any amount of Angel ally cards. Banish those cards along with any amount of Angel ally cards from your hand, memory, and/or graveyard. Shuffle your deck. Then draw a card into your memory for each card banished from your hand and memory this way.

engineBug.summary: Seraphic Legion's Descent's On Enter was not implemented.
